test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is/are true about globalisation?

I. It is about integration with world economies

II. It promotes competition among producers

III. Appreciation of domestic currency improves exports
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) Only I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Globalisation involves integration with world economies:** It includes the process of interaction and integration among people, companies, and governments worldwide. (Source: World Bank)
 
• **Promotes competition among producers:** Globalisation leads to increased competition as companies from different countries compete in the global market. (Source: OECD)
 
• **Appreciation of domestic currency:** Generally makes exports more expensive and less competitive, reducing export levels. (Source: International Monetary Fund)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trade Liberalisation:** The removal or reduction of trade barriers or restrictions on the free exchange of goods between nations. (Source: World Trade Organization)
 
• **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI):** An investment made by a firm or individual in one country into business interests located in another country. (Source: UNCTAD)
 
• **Exchange Rates:** The value of one currency for the purpose of conversion to another. Affects international trade and investments. (Source: Federal Reserve)
 
• **Multinational Corporations (MNCs):** Companies that operate in multiple countries. They play a significant role in globalisation. (Source: Harvard Business Review)
